sources.title: Donghyun1228/pi05-libero-current-vision-relation-scalar-yaw30-1000 ...
sources.snippet: The detached teacher combines current vision with the pretrained expert. The relation objective uses a t=1 one-step main flow estimate, not the complete sampler. Gram invariance permits reflections. No source observations, source output cache or success feedback enters training. Existing target instructions condition the policy. This individual checkpoint does not establish retention.

sources.title: GitHub - Donghyun1228/LIBERO_view: Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer in ...
sources.snippet: LIBERO is designed for studying knowledge transfer in multitask and lifelong robot learning problems. Successfully resolving these problems require both declarative knowledge about objects/spatial relationships and procedural knowledge about motion/behaviors.
